south.name: South Meadow
south.description: A broad sandy field beyond your southern hedge. More stripping and haul distance, with room to develop a second working face.
south.geology: Thick sand below useful topsoil; thinner gravel at depth.

ridge.name: East Ridge
ridge.description: A compact rock reserve beside the yard. Short hauls favour crushing, but its thin cover leaves little easy work for a shovel.
ridge.geology: Shallow rock beneath thin soil, clay, sand and gravel.
